message: I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock.
text:
I've drafted the daily loop as a machine called **Notes Files Improver** (`notes_files_improver`). It is unconfirmed, so it doesn't run and costs nothing until you confirm it.

- **What it does:** once a day it reads the Notes Files stock and what limited notes files landing. It picks one change to raise notes files added per day and hands it to the Coordinator, or asks you if it needs your choice. It never removes checks or merges anything.
- **Cost:** about one turn a day, roughly $0.03.
- **Expected effect:** Notes Files rises, judged 7 days after it starts. This is only published once you confirm the machine and tell me which discovered stock Notes Files is (my link tool binds them).
- **My guess:** I picked 09:00 UTC as the run time because you gave none. Tell me if you want a different time.
- **Stock measurement:** the Notes Files stock from earlier is still recording, as a draft that expires 2026-11-02 at 10:05 UTC unless you keep it.

Say "confirm it" to start the loop, and "keep it" to keep the measurement.
